title: Frank & Atticus – Boysenberry Swirl 100ml
description:
Frank & Atticus – Boysenberry Swirl 100ml
Frank & Atticus’ Boysenberry Swirl Tastes as zesty fresh boysenberries blended with sweet vanilla bean ice cream, giving you a smooth, pleasant vape that melts like the real thing on your tongue.
On the exhale, you’ll get a cookie and waffle experience, with a delicious moreish flavour that’ll keep you going back for more.
Frank & Atticus vape juices come 100ml bottles with 0MG nicotine. If you love dessert e-liquids, the Frank & Atticus juice range is a must-try!
